verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab has merge requests as its online code-change review surface: agents review code, security findings appear in MRs, and partners like CodeAnt add code reviews to MRs. A community note that the GitHub importer brings over PR review comments suggests GitLab stores review comments, but no first-party doc describes inline commenting or replying to review threads. Missing for 10: first-party docs on inline diff comments and threaded replies or resolution, and hands-on corroboration of the human review workflow.
